summary.text: Jeff Campbell is a Republican teacher and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 46 who is seeking re-election against Democrat Sarah Umberger in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2017 to 2020 and returned in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Campbell earned a B.A. in communications in 1996 and a B.S. in secondary education in 2008, both from Concord University.
His career experience includes working as a social studies teacher with Greenbrier County Schools and as sports director and an account executive with Radio Greenbrier.
Campbell represented West Virginia House of Delegates District 42 from 2017 to 2020, and on July 30, 2021, announced that he had joined the Republican Party.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Campbell to the House in 2023 to replace Michael Honaker, and he assumed office on September 15, 2023, representing District 46.
